title: Product B: Contraindications and Precautions
shortdesc: Information on safety, contraindications, and precautions for Product B.

sections.content:
Product B is contraindicated in patients with the following conditions:
- Known severe hypersensitivity to Product B or any of its excipients.
- Severe cardiogenic shock or uncompensated heart failure requiring inotropic support.
- Second-degree or third-degree atrioventricular (AV) block in the absence of a functioning pacemaker.

Before administering Product B, consider the following safety precautions:
- Monitor blood pressure and continuous electrocardiogram (ECG) during administration.
- Assess baseline renal function and serum potassium levels prior to initiating treatment.
- Use with caution in patients receiving concurrent beta-blockers or calcium channel blockers due to the risk of additive bradycardia.
